bodyHtml:
French IT translation services

Our IT translation service in French

For accurate French IT translation services, BeTranslated offers a team of experienced translators specialising in the technology sector. Whether you need translations for software localisation, technical documentation, user interfaces, API documentation, or website localisation, we have the expertise to deliver precise, contextually appropriate results.

Our French IT translators understand the terminology used across enterprise software, SaaS platforms, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and consumer technology. We work with formats including HTML, XML, JSON, YAML, and standard documentation formats, so your content is translation-ready and technically accurate.

Discover how BeTranslated can support your French IT translation projects.

Why choose BeTranslated for French IT translation?

Our IT translation services combine technical accuracy with cultural adaptation. Our translators are native French speakers with hands-on experience in the IT sector and thorough knowledge of industry terminology, from DevOps and agile methodologies to UX/UI, machine learning, and network infrastructure.

Every translation is technically precise and reads naturally for French-speaking users in France, Belgium, Switzerland, Canada, or francophone Africa.

What IT content do we translate?

We provide French IT translation services for:

  • Software interfaces and user manuals
  • Technical specifications and API documentation
  • Websites, web applications, and mobile apps
  • Knowledge bases, FAQs, and help centre content
  • Marketing collateral for tech products and SaaS platforms

Our translators work across software development, cybersecurity, cloud computing (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), fintech, e-commerce platforms, and enterprise IT systems including ERP and CRM solutions.

How do we maintain quality?

BeTranslated follows a structured localisation process. Our translators collaborate with your team to understand the technical context of your project, then adapt the content for your target audience, considering terminology preferences, regional variations, and user experience.

We use translation memory tools to maintain consistency across large projects and multiple releases, applying your glossary and style guide throughout.

What is the turnaround time?

Turnaround depends on project complexity and volume. We provide clear timelines upfront and can accommodate urgent deadlines when needed. For ongoing projects, we offer flexible scheduling to align with your software release cycles and sprint planning.

Get started

BeTranslated delivers accurate, culturally adapted French translations for IT projects of all sizes. Our specialist translators help you communicate technical content effectively to French-speaking audiences.
